title: SSC CGL Tier-1 Full Mock Test 05 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CGL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CGL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Book : Library :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: Books are kept/displayed in a library; paintings are displayed in a gallery.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Odometer : Speed :: Thermometer : ?
questions.explanation: Odometer measures distance/speed related travel; thermometer measures temperature.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If PAPER is coded as QBQFS, how is PENCIL coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: P→Q,E→F,N→O,C→D,I→J,L→M → QFODJM.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a certain code, 'SMART' is written as 'UQCTV'. How is 'BRAVE' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +2: B→D,R→T,A→C,V→X,E→G → DTCXG.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to the man?
questions.explanation: Grandfather's only son is the man's father; his daughter is the man's sister.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is B's sister. C is B's mother. D is C's father. E is D's mother. How is A related to D?
questions.explanation: D is A's maternal grandfather, so A is granddaughter of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A person walks 10 km East, then 6 km South, then 4 km West, then 6 km North. How far is he from the start?
questions.explanation: Net displacement = (10-4) km East = 6 km East; North-South cancel. Distance = 6 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Ravi starts from home, walks 5 km North, turns left and walks 3 km, turns left and walks 5 km. Where is he from home?
questions.explanation: N5, then West 3, then South 5 → 3 km West of home.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All pens are books. Some books are tables. Conclusions: I. Some pens are tables. II. All books are pens.
questions.explanation: Some books being tables does not force pens to be tables. II is converse of 'all pens are books' and does not follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All cats are dogs. All dogs are animals. Conclusions: I. All cats are animals. II. Some animals are cats.
questions.explanation: All cats → dogs → animals, so all cats are animals and some animals are cats.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a row of 40 students, A is 12th from the left and B is 18th from the right. How many students are between A and B?
questions.explanation: B from left = 40-18+1=23. Between 12 and 23: 10 students.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2023?
questions.explanation: 15 Aug 2023 to 15 Aug 2024 includes 29 Feb 2024, so 366 days = 2 odd days. Thursday minus 2 days = Tuesday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 4 and 5 o'clock are the hands of a clock together?
questions.explanation: Hands coincide at m = (30H)/5.5 = 120/5.5 = 240/11 = 21 9/11 minutes past 4.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A,B,C,D,E sit in a row facing North. A is at the left end. E is at the right end. B is second to the left of E. C is not next to A. Who sits in the middle?
questions.explanation: Positions: 1=A, 5=E. B is second to the left of E ⇒ position 3. Remaining 2 and 4 for C,D. C is not next to A ⇒ C ≠ 2 ⇒ C at 4, D at 2. Middle (pos 3) is B.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents: Doctors, Males, Engineers?
questions.explanation: A person can be male doctor engineer; categories overlap.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If a clock shows 3:40, the mirror image time is?
questions.explanation: Mirror of h:m is 11:60 minus time. 11:60-3:40=8:20.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal and a hole is punched near the fold. How many holes when unfolded?
questions.explanation: One fold (2 layers) yields 2 holes.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: How many squares are there in a 3×3 grid of unit squares?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All that glitters is not gold. Conclusions: I. Gold does not glitter. II. Some glittering things are not gold.
questions.explanation: The proverb means some glittering things are not gold.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: 8, 27, 64, 125, 216, 343
questions.explanation: 8, 27, 125, 216, 343 are cubes only. 64 is both 4³ and 8² (also a perfect square), so it is the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the odd one: Circle, Ellipse, Sphere, Parabola
questions.explanation: Sphere is 3-dimensional; others are plane curves.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If P > Q ≥ R = S < T, which is true?
questions.explanation: P > Q ≥ R = S ⇒ P > S.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
questions.explanation: Battle of Plassey, 23 June 1757, marked the start of British political power in India.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who was the first Indian Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the first Indian Governor-General (June 1948–January 1950). Mountbatten was the first GG after independence but was British.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the amendment procedure?
questions.explanation: Article 368 provides the power and procedure to amend the Constitution.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The idea of a Constituent Assembly was first put forward by?
questions.explanation: M.N. Roy proposed a Constituent Assembly in 1934.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which is the longest river entirely in India?
questions.explanation: Godavari is the longest river that flows entirely within India (~1465 km). Ganga originates in India but has a course also associated with Bangladesh.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: It passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, WB, Tripura, Mizoram — not Odisha.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Repo rate is the rate at which:
questions.explanation: Repo rate is the rate at which RBI lends short-term money to commercial banks against securities.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: GST in India was implemented from:
questions.explanation: GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The chemical formula of washing soda is:
questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate, Na2CO3·10H2O.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: SI unit of luminous intensity is:
questions.explanation: Candela (cd) is the SI base unit of luminous intensity.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which vitamin is synthesized in the human skin in presence of sunlight?
questions.explanation: UV-B helps convert 7-dehydrocholesterol in skin to vitamin D3.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Kyoto Protocol is related to:
questions.explanation: Kyoto Protocol (1997) set binding emission reduction targets for greenhouse gases.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The first Indian to win a Nobel Prize was:
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The term 'LBW' is associated with:
questions.explanation: Leg Before Wicket is a mode of dismissal in cricket.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Who wrote 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: Jawaharlal Nehru wrote The Discovery of India during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Kathakali dance form originated in:
questions.explanation: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama of Kerala.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which is the official language of the Union of India as per the Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article 343: official language of the Union is Hindi in Devanagari script.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Headquarters of the International Court of Justice is at:
questions.explanation: ICJ sits at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: INS Vikrant is India's first:
questions.explanation: INS Vikrant is India's first indigenously designed and built aircraft carrier.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: PM-KISAN provides income support of how much per year to eligible farmers?
questions.explanation: PM-KISAN gives ₹6,000 per year in three instalments.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: India is a member of which of the following?
questions.explanation: India is a member of the G20; not NATO, G7 or ANZUS.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a material medium; vacuum has none.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: pH of a neutral solution at 25°C is:
questions.explanation: Neutral water has [H+]=10^-7, pH=7 at 25°C.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which of the following is an input device?
questions.explanation: A scanner inputs images/documents into a computer.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Reserve Bank of India was established in:
questions.explanation: RBI was established on 1 April 1935 under the RBI Act, 1934.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Identify the part with error: The committee / have decided / to postpone / the meeting.
questions.explanation: Committee as a single body takes singular verb 'has decided'.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Identify the error: Neither of the two / candidates have / submitted their / documents yet.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular; use 'has'.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: He is senior _____ me by two years.
questions.explanation: Senior/junior/superior take preposition 'to'.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: The teacher insisted _____ punctuality.
questions.explanation: Insist on something.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Synonym of ABANDON:
questions.explanation: Abandon means to leave/forsake.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Synonym of METICULOUS:
questions.explanation: Meticulous = very careful and thorough.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Antonym of SCARCE:
questions.explanation: Scarce × plentiful/abundant.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Antonym of OPAQUE:
questions.explanation: Opaque × transparent/clear.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: To 'bury the hatchet' means:
questions.explanation: Bury the hatchet = end a quarrel; make peace.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: 'Hit the nail on the head' means:
options: To do or say exactly the right thing
questions.explanation: It means to be precisely correct.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: A person who loves books is called:
questions.explanation: Bibliophile = lover of books.

questions.subject: English Language

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Change to passive: They will complete the work tomorrow.
options: The work will be completed by them tomorrow.
The work would be completed tomorrow.
The work is completed by them tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future simple: will be + V3.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Change to active: The letter was written by her.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive → past simple active.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: He said, "I am unwell."
options: He said that he was unwell.
He said that I am unwell.
He said that he is unwell.
He told that he was unwell.
questions.explanation: Present → past in reported speech.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: She said to me, "Please wait here."
options: She requested me to wait there.
She said me to wait here.
She told me please wait there.
questions.explanation: Please → requested; here → there.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Neither Ramesh nor his friends _____ present.
questions.explanation: When subjects are joined by neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject (friends → were).

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: He congratulated me _____ my success.
questions.explanation: Congratulate someone on something.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: Honest begins with vowel sound → an.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Which sentence should come first? P: The rivers overflowed. Q: There was heavy rain. R: Many villages were flooded. S: Crops were destroyed.
questions.explanation: Cause first: heavy rain, then overflow, flood, crop loss.
